capabilities: chat with cloud and local LLM models
switch between model providers in each chat view
open chat views as a sidebar, tab, or floating popup
run a built-in MCP server for external clients to read and write the vault
extras: The MCP server is desktop-only, disabled by default, binds to 127.0.0.1, and requires a bearer token; write tools show confirmation dialogs in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with large language models or let external AI clients read and edit vault files.

relations.evidence: Install Ollama and pull the models you want to use
Claude Desktop, or any other MCP-compatible client, can read and write this vault directly

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Mistral API key
GPT4All or Ollama for local models

summary: AI chat plugin that connects to cloud LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral) and local models (GPT4All, Ollama) from sidebar, tab, or popup.
